title: P3585YHR Corn (Pioneer P3585YHR): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: P3585YHR Corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: P3585YHR corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Luzon and Mindanao. 105 to 107 days to harvest, 8.9 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: P3585YHR corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as Pioneer P3585YHR or 3585YHR. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2021 as NSIC 2021 GMCn 74. Corteva Agriscience bred it. It takes 105 to 107 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 8.89 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Pioneer P3585YHR or 3585YHR, this is the same corn. Its seller and farm sources add notes, listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng mais, step by step](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-mais).

items: **Days to harvest:** 105 to 107 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 8.89 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.
**Plant height:** about 214.7 cm.
**Recommended for:** Luzon and Mindanao.
**Type:** Yellow GM hybrid.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

P3585YHR corn takes 105 to 107 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 8.89 t/ha beats the average of its group, 8.13. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives 110 to 115 days, 105 to 107 in national trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 16.04 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 79.04 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** Potential 14 t/ha, shelling recovery up to 85 percent, national trials averaged 8.89 t/ha.

**Traits in the seed:** YHR, sold as Intrasect (MON810 x TC1507 x NK603): two Bt proteins, YieldGard Cry1Ab and Herculex Cry1F, against Asian corn borer and other caterpillars (Corteva pitched it against fall armyworm), plus Roundup Ready glyphosate tolerance, refuge seed mixed in the bag (5 percent), unlike the older YR hybrids that needed a separate 10 percent refuge.
**Season:** Wet and dry.
**Where:** Luzon and Mindanao.
Big ears and kernels.
Heavy grain.
Spacing 70 x 20 cm or 60 x 20 cm.
Shelling about 79 percent in national trials.
Erect leaves and good standability for high density planting.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: still the only Intrasect (YHR) hybrid on the Jan 2025 list, third (7.75 t/ha) in the 2022 Central Luzon corn derby (SunStar). These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual corn on the same ground.
Where and when to plant P3585YHR corn

It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is Pioneer P3585YHR the same as P3585YHR?
items.a: Yes. Pioneer P3585YHR is another name for P3585YHR, registered as NSIC 2021 GMCn 74. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 105 to 107 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 8.89 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of P3585YHR?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
